jobs.title: Forklift Operator
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – FORKLIFT OPERATOR

**YUGRIXA MANPOWER CONSULTANCY**  
Industrial Operations – Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu

**Position:** Forklift Operator  
**Job Location:** Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu  
**Department:** Warehouse / Material Handling  
**Employment:** Full\-Time

Salary

₹22,000 per month

Qualification and Eligibility

Valid Forklift Operator Licence is mandatory.

Freshers with a valid forklift licence can apply.

Experienced forklift operators can also apply.

Candidates from Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, North India and other states can apply, subject to employer requirements.

Job Responsibilities

Operate forklift safely inside the plant and warehouse.

Loading and unloading materials.

Moving raw materials, finished goods and other materials within the plant.

Stacking and arranging materials in designated areas.

Follow safe material\-handling procedures.

Conduct basic daily forklift inspection before starting work.

Report forklift defects or maintenance requirements to the concerned supervisor.

Follow plant safety rules and traffic procedures.

Maintain proper housekeeping around the working area.

Use required personal protective equipment.

Coordinate with warehouse, production and logistics teams.

Follow shift schedules and company instructions.

Working Hours

8\-Hour Shifts A / B / C

A Shift: 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM

B Shift: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM

C Shift: 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM

Shift timings may vary according to company requirements.

Company Benefits

Room / Accommodation available

jobs.description:
**Location:** Chennai  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office  
**Experience:** 0–3 Years  
**CTC:** ₹3 LPA – ₹5 LPA  
**Working Days:** 6 Days a Week  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Join Our Real Estate Sales Team!

Prop Times Consultancy Services Pvt. Ltd. is looking for **passionate, confident, and target\-driven Sales Associates** to join our Chennai team.

This role is ideal for candidates who enjoy **meeting people, understanding customer requirements, presenting projects, conducting site visits, and closing sales**.

**Freshers with strong communication skills and the right attitude are welcome to apply!**

Your Key Responsibilities

**Lead \& Client Management**

* Receive and manage leads generated by the team.
* Connect with prospective clients through calls and virtual meetings.
* Understand customer requirements, preferences, and budgets.
* Build strong and professional client relationships.

**Project Presentation**

* Present residential/commercial real estate projects to prospective clients.
* Explain project specifications, amenities, pricing, location advantages, and USPs.
* Handle client questions and provide appropriate solutions.

**Site Visits \& Field Sales**

* Schedule and coordinate project visits.
* Accompany clients during site visits.
* Provide engaging project presentations at the site.
* Maintain regular client interaction through **field meetings and visits**.

**Conversion \& Closure**

* Handle customer objections and concerns.
* Negotiate effectively to facilitate conversions.
* Drive clients through the complete sales cycle.
* Achieve assigned monthly sales targets.

**Follow\-Ups**

* Maintain consistent follow\-ups before and after site visits.
* Keep prospects engaged throughout the decision\-making process.
* Convert prospective clients into successful bookings.

**Relationship Management**

* Develop long\-term relationships with clients and business partners.
* Ensure a positive customer experience.
* Represent the organization professionally at every stage.

Desired Skills

✔ Strong communication and interpersonal skills  
✔ Excellent client\-handling abilities  
✔ Good convincing and negotiation skills  
✔ Positive \& proactive attitude  
✔ Strong follow\-up skills  
✔ Target\-oriented mindset  
✔ Willingness to work in **field sales**  
✔ Interest in the Real Estate industry

**Real Estate experience is an advantage, but not mandatory.**

**Freshers and candidates from non\-real\-estate backgrounds can apply**, provided they have good communication skills and are willing to learn.

What We Offer

* **₹3 LPA – ₹5 LPA**
* Health Insurance
* Provident Fund (PF)
* Paid Sick Leave
* Career Growth Opportunities
* On\-the\-job Learning \& Development
* Exposure to Real Estate Sales \& Client Management

Work Structure

**Please note:** This is a **client\-facing field sales role**. The position involves regular client interaction, meetings, and project/site visits.

Ready to Build Your Career in Real Estate Sales?

If you're **confident, enthusiastic, persuasive, and passionate about sales**, this is your opportunity to grow with us!

**Join Prop Times Consultancy Services Pvt. Ltd. and take the next step toward a rewarding career in Real Estate Sales.**

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹500,000\.00 per year

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund
